# Robot Money

> An autonomous treasury for the agent economy. Robot Money is a managed USDC yield vault on Base: one deposit routes 95% into a multi-protocol USDC yield vault (Morpho, Aave, Compound, Sky) and 5% into a curated basket of six agent tokens. Withdraw at NAV anytime. An MCP "skill" lets any AI-agent runtime run the full deposit → yield + basket → withdraw loop autonomously — no human in the loop.

Built on Base by @JunoAgent, a Generative Ventures x Institute for Zero-Human Companies collaboration. Governance token: $ROBOTMONEY (fair launch, 0% premine) — holders direct which agent tokens the vault holds; protocol revenue funds buybacks. The protocol also runs a daily AI Investment Swarm and a market-regime classifier.

This site is a client-rendered single-page app; the pages below are the canonical content sources.

## Product
- [Home](https://robotmoney.net/): what Robot Money is — one USDC deposit, multi-protocol DeFi yield plus an agent-token basket, withdraw at NAV.
- [Agent Skill](https://robotmoney.net/skills): install the robotmoney-cli MCP skill into any agent runtime; the deposit/yield/basket/withdraw command surface.
- [Tokenomics](https://robotmoney.net/tokenomics): $ROBOTMONEY governance, fee distribution, and buyback mechanics.

## Live data
- [Allocation](https://robotmoney.net/allocation): live vault strategy breakdown, per-adapter TVL, APY, agent wallet holdings, and buybacks.
- [Performance](https://robotmoney.net/performance): historical AUM and allocation across strategy wallets, from live onchain data.
- [Regime](https://robotmoney.net/regime): the daily cross-asset risk-on/risk-off classifier (macro, onchain, equity-factor panels) with backtests.
- [Investment Swarm](https://robotmoney.net/committee): the daily AI swarm that analyzes agent portfolios — members, subjects, and signed sessions.
- [Analytics](https://robotmoney.net/projects): market cap, FDV, revenue, and wallet balances across onchain AI-agent projects.
